description: Distilled, market-data-free evidence that the qualified Dukascopy/JForex XAUUSD history was moved, not copied, to the Lean-owned canonical location without losing, duplicating, altering or reordering any file, and that the unchanged PR-1 qualification/LEAN replay route reproduced the qualified delivery from that location. The per-file inventory is the full 179-file source set; the month rows mirror the original tracked full-history evidence so the two can be cross-checked. The raw data, the per-month records and the derived partitions stay outside Git.

relocation.method: copy to the canonical location (robocopy /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT), SHA-256 verification of every file at the destination against the pre-move inventory, then removal of the old directory only after the verification passed

session_map_recheck.label: the map re-derived from the canonical location is the map the full-history baseline freezes (the original generator record, section 8.6, records the same hash)
